snippet.title: Sole Mates : Tidy Up Store
snippet.description:
👟 The shoe store won’t organize itself.

Find every shoe’s perfect mate and put each pair in the right place… but don’t mix them up! 👀

Can you match them all before the store gets completely out of control?

🎮 Sole Mates: Tidy Up the Shoe Store

🔥 Wishlist now on Steam!
